title: Troubadour - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Troubadour in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Light lands and Dark is resisted. Its Chromatic form drops Troubadim.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toLight
ResistsDark
AbsorbsNone
ImmuneNone

Bring Light damage. Dark is resisted, so those turns are wasted.

sections.title: How to Beat the Troubadour
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Light is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.

What not to bring

  • It resists Dark, so that damage is halved.
